note: Bourbon County KS: county GIS page links only the KansasGIS ORKA viewer (parcels/floodplain, no zoning layer). The ArcGIS 'Bourbon County Zoning Map' found under bourboncountyplanning.com/zoning is Kentucky's Bourbon County (Paris, Millersburg, North Middletown), not Kansas. Kansas county is only now contracting a countywide zoning code (news). Fort Scott zoning districts exist per city pages, but only as PDF/historic 1964 map; no queryable district layer found for Fort Scott, Uniontown, or Mapleton.
